note: Beauregard Parish publishes no queryable zoning district service. The only zoning for DeRidder (the city, which zones its own land) is a static city zoning map graphic and PDF (2021 map, legend R-1 to I-1). No ArcGIS REST zoning layer found for the parish or for DeRidder in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches, and the parish GIS viewers (atlas.geoportalmaps.com/beauregard, bpassessor.com) expose no zoning service. Parish-wide zoning is not confirmed; a third-party source says the Police Jury handles unincorporated zoning but no official layer was found.
